visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed band with a looping, muted background video (Vimeo/YouTube/mp4 link) and overlaid white text, no CTA
visualCharacteristics.layout: text overlaid on a cover-fit background video; optional poster image shown behind the video and used instead of it under prefers-reduced-motion
visualCharacteristics.source: https://bradescobank.com/en/ sections rc3 (H1 over Vimeo 963210681) and rc8 (statement paragraph over Vimeo 963210796)

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background cell holding a video link (e.g. https://vimeo.com/963210681) and/or a poster image; row 2: content cell with a heading or statement paragraph, optional description and optional CTA link

cells: Background: video link (Vimeo, YouTube or .mp4) and/or optional poster image
Heading (H1) or statement paragraph, optional description, optional CTA

usage: Use for full-width page-opening or interstitial bands whose background is a looping video.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any background-video banner; use hero-promo when the background is a still photo with a CTA.
